انفضحن (form VII)
# اِنْفَضَحْنَ (infaḍaḥna) /in.fa.dˤaħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضِحْنَ (infaḍiḥna) /in.fa.dˤiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
